before.season: **SEASON:** Autumn. What a window or door shows of the outdoors is autumn's, the same place alike from page to page; the room itself shows no season.

after.light: **LIGHT:** the place is lit evenly by its own lamps and panels; any window or opening shows what lies outside this world, never the sky or daylight of an Earth day. It wins over the light and weather of any reference image.
